# DEGREE 4, DIAMETER 6: 760 VERTICES
# ----------------------------------
# 760 vertices, 1,520 undirected edges, every vertex of degree 4, every pair of vertices within 6
# steps of each other.
#
# The incidence graph of the generalized hexagon H(3) (364 points and 364 lines; 4-regular,
# bipartite, girth 12, diameter 6) with 32 flags subdivided: a new vertex is placed on each of 32
# point-line incidence edges and joined to that point and that line, and the 32 new vertices carry
# a 2-regular graph F with cycles of lengths 8, 8 and 16.
#
# The 32 flags are the union of two 16-flag orbits of a Sylow 2-subgroup (order 128) of Aut(H(3))
# = G_2(3):2 inside the centraliser of an involution. F has no edge between the two orbits, so the
# graph is two 744-vertex solutions glued together.
#
# Vertices 0..363 are the points of H(3), 364..727 its lines and 728..759 the 32 new vertices.
#
# One edge "u v" per line, vertices numbered 0..759.
